notes.title: Demo Crash Issues Fixed!
notes.notes: [p]The game shipped with a DLL file that was incompatible with some configurations and caused crashes upon launch. These issues have been fixed now. Please update the demo to get the updated version. I apologize for any crashes that might have occured and hope you'll give the demo another chance.[/p]

notes.title: Bits at Work (Bit ESC Prologue)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Bit ESC is a game set in a fictional operating system which you, Bit, are trying to escape from. But why this theme/setting.

For context, Bit ESC is a solo-developed project so a lot of the inspirations stem from personal experiences.

Bit ESC is inspired by a period of burnout I was going through. Even though I was barely able to function professionally, I still had to work every weekday and stare at a glaring computer screen and chip away at tasks on the OS. I'd often daydream about escaping this never-ending work cycle somehow. Defying the norm. Breaking free. Realistically that'll never happen but maybe, just maybe, I could make a game about it? Thus Bit ESC was born.

Ironically, I'm still staring at a screen all day working on Bit ESC.

Given these inspirations, an old demo that didn't meet my standards (that demo has since been taken down) and the need to further test Bit ESC's proprietary game-engine, I wanted to make something Bit ESC-y but not really. So...

Announcing [b]Bits at Work[/b], an office management simulation game set in the Bit ESC world. Create, manage and expand your office, make sure your bits are happy, and maximize profits. Coming very very soon for the low low price of [b]FREE[/b].

[previewyoutube=4Mpr0t0dtsY;full][/previewyoutube]

P.S. Bit ESC's development is still going strong. Stay tuned for more announcements soon.

notes.title: Bit ESC is joining PixElated Fest on July 29th!
notes.notes:
We all love pixel art games. So, let’s celebrate together 🎉 I'm super excited to share that [b]Bit ESC[/b] joins [b]PixElated Festival[/b]!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41353515/a87959164fe18536c6a80633c21a56c4453998ed.png[/img]

👀 To celebrate, stay tuned for a new trailer for Bit ESC when the festival starts July 29th!

This festival will feature some of the best pixel art games on Steam. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems all in one place with ✨ discounts ✨ live streams ✨ art contest ✨ demos✨ developer chats ✨ all centered around your favorite pixel art games.

Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: [url=]http://pixelatedfest.com/[/url]

notes.title: WshWsha is now Bit ESC
notes.notes: While I love the name WshWsha, non-Arabic-speakers found it hard to pronounce and, due to it's difficulty, couldn't remember the name. So now WshWsha is Bit ESC!
